title: Der Finsterwald — Die alte Mühle
blurb: A dark-fairy-tale scenario at the edge of the Finsterwald. Goblins have driven Miller Bodo from his mill, and something in the woods has made them bold. A sword, a talent probe, and too much courage — that's all you have.

weyhersbrunn.name: Weyhersbrunn am Finsterwald
weyhersbrunn.description: A rain-soaked village on the forest's edge: an inn, a square, a path into the dark trees, and an old mill that no longer grinds.
